title: In the heart of Seville
text: We really enjoyed the tour with Mari Paz, who helped us discover Seville through its history and roots, visiting all the most relevant parts of the city. It was a stroke of luck to have the knowledge of a historian and the passion of a Sevillian woman. It was an honor to spend 2 wonderful hours with her, and we are leaving Seville wanting to return to continue exploring and enjoying it.

title: Conscientious and entertaining
text: Mari Paz is an excellent guide with knowledge, passion and love of art. I did a series of private tours with her for an investigation of a book background and Mari Paz linked the visits and the information made my needs. In addition, it is very bearable, and has suggestions for how to have a good time in Seville and its environments.

title: Expectacular tour of Seville
